She's having her hair cut.

topics.title: Non-defining relative clauses
topics.description: Mệnh đề quan hệ bổ sung, có dấu phẩy

lessons.title: who / which thêm thông tin, không xác định danh từ
lessons.explanation:
Mệnh đề không xác định thêm thông tin phụ. Có dấu phẩy, và bỏ đi câu vẫn đủ nghĩa.

• My sister, who lives in Hue, is a doctor.
• The report, which was finished late, has several errors.

Không dùng that. Không lược bỏ who / which.

examples.en: My sister, who lives in Hue, is a doctor.
The old bridge, which was built in 1920, is still used.

exercises.question: My uncle, ___ lives in Da Nang, is visiting us.
The report, ___ was sent yesterday, is too long.
Không dùng ___ trong mệnh đề không xác định.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: Mệnh đề bổ sung, có dấu phẩy, không dùng that.

examples.en: Lan, who lives next door, is a nurse.
Hue, which I visited, is quiet.

exercises.question: My brother, ___ lives in Da Nang, is a chef.
The book, ___ I finished yesterday, was sad.
Ha Long, ___ is famous, is in Quang Ninh.

topics.title: Unless and provided that
topics.description: Điều kiện phủ định và điều kiện bắt buộc

lessons.title: unless = if not; provided that = chỉ khi
lessons.explanation:
unless thay cho if ... not: Unless you book early, the course will be full.
provided that / as long as đưa điều kiện phải có: You can borrow the car provided that you return it tonight.

unless không đi với will trong mệnh đề của nó: Unless it rains, we will walk.

examples.en: Unless you leave now, you will miss the train.
You can go out provided that you finish your homework.

exercises.question: ___ you hurry, you will miss the bus.
You may leave early ___ that the report is finished.
Unless it ___, we will have the picnic.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: unless = if not. provided that = only if.

examples.en: Unless you hurry, we'll be late.
You can go provided that you finish.

exercises.question: You may leave ___ that the work is done.
I won't go ___ you come too.

topics.title: Be supposed to
topics.description: be supposed to — được cho là, lẽ ra phải

lessons.title: Nghĩa vụ hoặc điều người khác trông đợi
lessons.explanation:
be supposed to + V nói việc ai đó được kỳ vọng phải làm, hoặc điều người ta tin.

• You are supposed to wear a helmet.
• The meeting was supposed to start at nine.
• It is supposed to be a quiet area.

Quá khứ was supposed to thường có nghĩa việc đó đã không xảy ra như kỳ vọng.

examples.en: Students are supposed to hand in the essay on Friday.
The train was supposed to arrive at six.

exercises.question: You ___ supposed to switch off your phone.
The film was supposed to ___ at eight.
It is supposed ___ a very good book.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: be supposed to: được cho là, hoặc lẽ ra phải.

examples.en: The train is supposed to leave at 8.
You're not supposed to park here.

exercises.question: The meeting is ___ to start at nine.

topics.title: In order to and so as to
topics.description: Mục đích với to, in order to, so as to

lessons.title: Nói lý do mình làm một việc
lessons.explanation:
in order to / so as to + V nói mục đích. to + V cũng được và ngắn hơn.

• She left early in order to catch the bus.
• He spoke quietly so as not to wake the baby.

Phủ định là in order not to / so as not to, không phải so as to not.

examples.en: She studies at night in order to pass the exam.
He whispered so as not to wake the baby.

exercises.question: I came early ___ to get a good seat.
She walked quietly so as ___ to wake anyone.
He took a taxi in order ___ the train.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: in order to và so as to + nguyên mẫu chỉ mục đích. so as not to / in order not to cho phủ định.

examples.en: She whispered in order to avoid a scene.
He left early so as not to miss the bus.

exercises.question: I came early ___ to get a seat.
She spoke slowly so as ___ to confuse us.
He studied hard in order ___ pass.

topics.title: Shouldn't have
topics.description: should have / shouldn't have — đáng lẽ

lessons.title: Nhìn lại việc đã xảy ra
lessons.explanation:
should have + V3 nói việc đáng lẽ đã làm. shouldn't have + V3 nói việc đáng lẽ không làm.

• I should have left earlier.
• You shouldn't have said that.

Đây là nhận xét về quá khứ, không phải nghĩa vụ ở hiện tại (should + V).

examples.en: I should have checked the address.
You shouldn't have left the door open.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: should have + V3: đáng lẽ đã làm. shouldn't have: đáng lẽ không làm.

examples.en: You should have called.
I shouldn't have said that.

topics.title: The more the more
topics.description: So sánh kép: the + so sánh ... the + so sánh

lessons.title: Hai vế thay đổi cùng nhau
lessons.explanation:
the + comparative, the + comparative nói hai điều tăng hoặc giảm cùng lúc.

• The harder you practise, the better you get.
• The more I read, the more I enjoy it.

Tính từ ngắn thêm -er. Tính từ dài dùng more. Không dùng more more.

examples.en: The earlier we leave, the less traffic we meet.
The more carefully you check, the fewer mistakes you make.

exercises.question: The ___ you practise, the better you become.
The harder she worked, ___ tired she felt.
The sooner we start, the ___ we will finish.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: the + so sánh, the + so sánh: hai thứ cùng tăng hoặc cùng giảm.

examples.en: The more you practise, the better you get.
The harder it rained, the slower we drove.

exercises.question: The ___ she studies, the better her marks.
The older he gets, the ___ he travels.
The more I listened, ___ more I understood.

topics.title: It is said that
topics.description: Cấu trúc tường thuật vô nhân xưng

lessons.title: it is said that / he is said to
lessons.explanation:
Khi không cần nêu ai nói, dùng it is said / believed / reported that ...
Hoặc đưa người lên trước: He is said to be very strict.

• It is believed that the plan will change.
• She is reported to have left the company.

have + V3 khi việc đã xảy ra: is said to have resigned.

examples.en: It is said that the museum will close.
The minister is reported to have resigned.

exercises.question: It is ___ that the bridge is unsafe.
She is said to ___ the prize last year.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: it is said/thought/believed that, hoặc chủ ngữ + be said to.

examples.en: It is said that the house is haunted.
She is believed to be abroad.

exercises.question: It is ___ that the minister will resign.
They are reported ___ left the country.

topics.title: It's time and if only
topics.description: Ước và việc đáng lẽ đã xảy ra

lessons.title: it's time / if only + quá khứ đơn hoặc quá khứ hoàn thành
lessons.explanation:
It's time + quá khứ đơn nói việc đáng lẽ phải làm rồi: It's time we left.
If only + quá khứ đơn ước hiện tại: If only I knew.
If only + past perfect ước quá khứ: If only I had checked.

Động từ ở quá khứ nhưng nghĩa là hiện tại hoặc quá khứ, không phải một sự thật đã xảy ra.

examples.en: It's time we went home.
If only I had saved the file.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: It's time + quá khứ: đã đến lúc đáng lẽ phải xảy ra. if only + quá khứ hoặc had + V3.

examples.en: It's time we left.
If only I had listened.

exercises.question: It's high time she ___ the truth.
If only we ___ taken a map.

topics.title: Comment adverbs
topics.description: Trạng từ nêu thái độ người nói

lessons.title: apparently, admittedly, presumably đứng tách khỏi động từ
lessons.explanation:
Comment adverbs nói thái độ của người viết, thường đứng đầu câu và có dấu phẩy.

• Apparently, the meeting has been cancelled.
• Admittedly, the first draft was weak.
• Presumably, they will write back this week.

Chúng không bổ nghĩa cho động từ theo cách trạng từ cách thức (carefully, slowly).

examples.en: Apparently, the shop is closed on Mondays.
Admittedly, the test was harder than I expected.

exercises.question: ___, nobody told us about the change.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: Trạng từ như fortunately, apparently, admittedly nêu thái độ người nói.

examples.en: Fortunately, no one was hurt.
Apparently, the train is late.

exercises.question: ___, the keys were in my pocket.

topics.title: I think so
topics.description: so và not thay cho cả mệnh đề

lessons.title: think so, hope not, I'm afraid so
lessons.explanation:
so thay một mệnh đề khẳng định vừa nói. not thay mệnh đề phủ định.

• Will it rain? I think so. / I hope not.
• Is the shop open? I'm afraid not.

Dùng được với think, hope, believe, expect, be afraid, suppose. Không nói I think yes.

examples.en: Will they come? I think so.
Has the train left? I hope not.

exercises.question: Is the cafe open? I think ___.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: so thay mệnh đề khẳng định sau think, hope, believe. not hoặc not so cho phủ định, tùy động từ.

examples.en: Will it rain? I think so.
I hope not.

topics.title: Apposition
topics.description: Danh từ đứng cạnh danh từ để giải thích

lessons.title: Hai cụm danh từ chỉ cùng một người hoặc vật
lessons.explanation:
Apposition đặt một cụm danh từ ngay sau cụm khác để gọi tên hoặc giải thích.

• Ms Lan, the course tutor, will meet you at noon.
• We visited Hue, a city in central Vietnam.

Cụm giải thích thường có dấu phẩy nếu là thông tin phụ.

examples.en: Mr Khan, the new manager, starts on Monday.
We stayed in Hoi An, a town on the central coast.

exercises.question: Ms Hoa, ___ course tutor, is away today.
We visited Hue, ___ city in central Vietnam.
My friend Nam, ___ engineer, designed the bridge.

lessons.title: Luyện thêm
lessons.explanation: Danh từ đứng cạnh danh từ để giải thích, thường có dấu phẩy.

examples.en: Ha Noi, the capital, is busy.
My friend Lan, a doctor, lives nearby.

exercises.question: Paris, ___ of France, is on the Seine.
The novel, a ___ story, won a prize.

topics.title: Countable and uncountable nouns
topics.description: Danh từ đếm được và không đếm được — lỗi số 1 trong Writing của người Việt

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
Danh từ không đếm được KHÔNG có số nhiều và KHÔNG đi với a/an.
Hay gặp trong IELTS: information, advice, research, evidence, knowledge, equipment, furniture, traffic, pollution, transport, accommodation, homework, news, progress, feedback, behaviour, money, damage, litter.

Sai: many informations, an advice, researches, a lot of equipments
Đúng: much information, a piece of advice, research (hoặc studies), a lot of equipment

Lượng từ:
• many / a few / few / a number of + danh từ đếm được số nhiều
• much / a little / little / an amount of + danh từ không đếm được
• a lot of / some / plenty of: dùng được cho cả hai

Muốn đếm danh từ không đếm được: a piece of advice, two items of news, a great deal of research.

Dùng trong IELTS: Task 1 hay sai "the number of" và "the amount of". The number of + đếm được (the number of cars); the amount of + không đếm được (the amount of water).

examples.en: Research shows that children learn better through play.
She gave me a useful piece of advice.
The amount of traffic has increased dramatically.
The number of tourists doubled between 2000 and 2010.

exercises.question: Students need more ___ about university courses.
exercises.explanation: Information không đếm được, không có dạng số nhiều.

exercises.question: My teacher gave me some useful ___.
exercises.explanation: Advice (danh từ) không đếm được; advise là động từ.

exercises.question: ___ research has been done on this topic.
exercises.explanation: Research không đếm được nên dùng a great deal of, không dùng many/several.

exercises.question: The chart shows the ___ of water used by households.
exercises.explanation: Water không đếm được → the amount of.

exercises.question: The chart shows the ___ of cars sold each year.
exercises.explanation: Cars đếm được → the number of.

exercises.question: There is too ___ traffic in the city centre.
exercises.explanation: Traffic không đếm được → much.

exercises.question: The hotel offers comfortable ___.
exercises.explanation: Trong tiếng Anh-Anh, accommodation là danh từ không đếm được.

lessons.title: Luyện tập kiểu IELTS (tìm lỗi sai)
lessons.explanation:
Khi soát bài Writing, gạch chân mọi danh từ chung và hỏi: từ này đếm được không? Nếu không, kiểm tra ba chỗ: không có -s, không có a/an, lượng từ phải là much/little/amount.
Mẹo: news luôn đi với động từ số ít (The news is good).

examples.en: The news is surprisingly positive.
Scientists have made little progress.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The government should spend (B) more money on (C) public transports to (D) reduce congestion.
exercises.explanation: Transport (giao thông nói chung) không đếm được → public transport.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Many (B) evidences (C) suggest that exercise (D) improves memory.
exercises.explanation: Evidence không đếm được → much evidence / a lot of evidence suggests.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The news (B) are often (C) negative, which (D) worries viewers.
exercises.explanation: News là danh từ không đếm được, đi với động từ số ít: the news is.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Modern offices need (B) a lot of (C) equipments such as (D) printers.
exercises.explanation: Equipment không đếm được, không thêm -s.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Children should do (B) their homeworks (C) before (D) watching TV.
exercises.explanation: Homework không đếm được → their homework.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Pollution causes serious damage to health.
exercises.explanation: Pollution và damage (nghĩa thiệt hại) đều không đếm được.
options: Pollution causes serious damages to health.
Pollution causes a serious damage to health.
Pollution causes serious damage to health.
Pollutions cause serious damage to health.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Few people have enough knowledge of first aid.
exercises.explanation: Knowledge không đếm được; people đếm được → few people.
options: Few people have enough knowledges of first aid.
Few people have enough knowledge of first aid.
Little people have enough knowledge of first aid.
Few people have enough a knowledge of first aid.

exercises.question: The teacher gave ___ feedback on my essay.
exercises.explanation: Feedback không đếm được, không đi với a.

topics.title: Subject–verb agreement
topics.description: Hòa hợp chủ ngữ và động từ trong câu dài

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
Động từ phải hợp với CHỦ NGỮ CHÍNH, không hợp với danh từ đứng gần nó.

1. Cụm dài: The number of students IS rising. (chủ ngữ chính: the number)
   A number of students ARE absent. (a number of = nhiều → số nhiều)
2. Mệnh đề quan hệ: People who live in cities HAVE more stress.
3. Every / each / everyone / nobody → số ít: Every student HAS a laptop.
4. V-ing / mệnh đề làm chủ ngữ → số ít: Reading books IS relaxing.
5. Danh từ không đếm được → số ít: Information IS available online.
6. Either/neither ... or/nor: hợp với danh từ gần động từ.
7. There is/are: hợp với danh từ phía sau. There ARE many reasons.

Dùng trong IELTS: câu Task 1 dài như "The proportion of people who use public transport ___" rất dễ sai. Tìm chủ ngữ chính trước khi chia động từ.

examples.en: The percentage of households with internet access has risen.
One of the main reasons is cost.
Learning languages helps children think flexibly.

exercises.question: The number of cars on the road ___ increasing.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ chính là the number → số ít.

exercises.question: A number of experts ___ that the policy will fail.
exercises.explanation: A number of + danh từ số nhiều = nhiều → số nhiều.

exercises.question: One of the biggest problems ___ unemployment.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ chính là one → số ít.

exercises.question: Everyone in my class ___ to pass the exam.
exercises.explanation: Everyone → số ít.

exercises.question: Living in big cities ___ many advantages.
exercises.explanation: V-ing làm chủ ngữ → số ít.

exercises.question: People who work long hours ___ less time with their families.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ chính là people → số nhiều; mệnh đề who không đổi điều đó.

exercises.question: There ___ several reasons for this trend.
exercises.explanation: There are + danh từ số nhiều (several reasons).

lessons.title: Luyện tập kiểu IELTS (tìm lỗi sai)
lessons.explanation: Cách soát nhanh: với mỗi động từ chia thì, gạch bỏ mọi cụm giới từ (of..., in..., with...) và mệnh đề quan hệ đứng giữa, rồi đọc lại chủ ngữ + động từ.

examples.en: The quality of the roads in rural areas is poor.
Neither the teacher nor the students were ready.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The proportion of young people (B) who (C) owns a car (D) has fallen.
exercises.explanation: Who thay cho young people (số nhiều) → who own.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The quality of (B) public services in many cities (C) are (D) declining.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ chính là the quality → is declining.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Each of the (B) students (C) have (D) a different timetable.
exercises.explanation: Each of + danh từ số nhiều → động từ số ít: has.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The information (B) on these websites (C) are not (D) always reliable.
exercises.explanation: Information không đếm được → is not.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Watching too many videos (B) make children (C) less (D) active.
exercises.explanation: V-ing làm chủ ngữ → makes.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: The cost of houses in the capital has doubled.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ chính: the cost → has.
options: The cost of houses in the capital have doubled.
The cost of houses in the capital has doubled.
The cost of houses in the capital are doubled.
The costs of houses in the capital has doubled.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Neither the manager nor the workers were informed.
exercises.explanation: Neither ... nor: động từ hợp với danh từ gần nhất (the workers → were).
options: Neither the manager nor the workers was informed.
Neither the manager nor the workers were informed.
Neither the manager nor the workers is informed.
Neither the manager or the workers were informed.

exercises.question: Statistics ___ a compulsory subject for economics students.
exercises.explanation: Statistics là tên môn học → số ít. (Còn 'the statistics show' = các số liệu → số nhiều.)

topics.title: Articles in academic writing
topics.description: Mạo từ a/an/the và mạo từ rỗng trong bài viết học thuật

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
1. Nói chung chung → KHÔNG dùng the:
   Technology changes how we live. Children need exercise. Pollution harms health.
2. Đã xác định / duy nhất / có cụm bổ nghĩa phía sau → THE:
   The technology used in hospitals is expensive. The government. The environment. The internet.
3. Danh từ đếm được số ít luôn cần mạo từ (a/an/the) hoặc từ hạn định (my, this...):
   Sai: Car is useful. Đúng: A car is useful. / Cars are useful.
4. So sánh nhất, số thứ tự → the: the highest, the first, the second half.
5. Task 1: the number of, the proportion of, the figure for, in the UK, in the USA (quốc gia số nhiều/có "Kingdom/States"), nhưng in France, in Japan.
6. Năm và thập kỷ: in 2010, in the 1990s; over the period.

Dùng trong IELTS: Task 2 hay sai kiểu "The education is important" (nói chung → Education is important) hoặc thiếu mạo từ trước danh từ số ít.

examples.en: Education is the key to reducing poverty.
The education system in Finland is admired worldwide.
The figure for Japan was the lowest.
In the 1990s, the internet changed society.

exercises.question: ___ is important for every child.
exercises.explanation: Nói về giáo dục nói chung → không dùng the.

exercises.question: ___ in this country is free until the age of 18.
exercises.explanation: Hệ thống cụ thể (của nước này) → the.

exercises.question: Many people use ___ every day.
exercises.explanation: The internet là duy nhất → luôn có the.

exercises.question: The figure for ___ was higher than that for France.
exercises.explanation: The United Kingdom → the UK.

exercises.question: ___ is a good way to stay healthy.
exercises.explanation: Hoạt động nói chung → không mạo từ.

topics.title: Sentence structure: run-ons and fragments
topics.description: Câu cụt, câu dính và lỗi nối câu bằng dấu phẩy

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
Ba lỗi cấu trúc câu làm tụt điểm Grammatical Range & Accuracy:

1. Câu cụt (fragment): thiếu chủ ngữ hoặc động từ chính, hoặc chỉ có mệnh đề phụ.
   Sai: Because many people live in cities.
   Đúng: Because many people live in cities, housing is expensive.
2. Nối câu bằng dấu phẩy (comma splice): hai mệnh đề độc lập chỉ ngăn bằng dấu phẩy.
   Sai: Cars are convenient, they cause pollution.
   Đúng: Cars are convenient, but they cause pollution. / Cars are convenient; however, they cause pollution.
3. Câu dính (run-on): hai mệnh đề viết liền không có dấu câu hay từ nối.

Cách sửa: dấu chấm, dấu chấm phẩy (;), liên từ (and, but, so, because, although, while), hoặc đổi một vế thành mệnh đề phụ.
Lưu ý: however, therefore, moreover là trạng từ, KHÔNG nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy được: dùng dấu chấm hoặc chấm phẩy trước nó.

examples.en: Many students work part-time; as a result, they have less time to study.
Although online courses are cheap, they require strong self-discipline.
Prices rose sharply. However, demand remained high.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Many people prefer cars. However, cars cause pollution.
exercises.explanation: However không nối hai mệnh đề bằng dấu phẩy: dùng dấu chấm hoặc chấm phẩy trước however.

Many people prefer cars. However, cars cause pollution.

Many people prefer cars, however cars cause pollution.

options: Because the rent is high, many young people live with their parents.
The rent is high, many young people live with their parents.
Because the rent is high many young people they live with their parents.

options: Which is why the policy failed.

lessons.title: Luyện tập kiểu IELTS (tìm lỗi sai)
lessons.explanation: Đếm động từ chia thì trong câu: hai động từ chia thì → phải có từ nối (and, but, because, which...) hoặc dấu chấm phẩy giữa chúng.

options: Many people moved to the city, this caused a housing shortage.

topics.title: Contrast: despite, although, whereas, while
topics.description: Diễn đạt sự tương phản và nhượng bộ — cấu trúc nào đi với gì

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
1. Although / Even though + MỆNH ĐỀ (S + V)
   Although the course is expensive, many students choose it.
2. Despite / In spite of + DANH TỪ / V-ing / the fact that + mệnh đề
   Despite the high cost, ... / Despite being expensive, ... / Despite the fact that it is expensive, ...
   Sai: Despite it is expensive. / Despite of the cost.
3. However / Nevertheless: trạng từ, đứng đầu câu mới, sau nó là dấu phẩy.
4. Whereas / While: so sánh hai sự việc đối lập (rất hợp Task 1):
   Sales in Japan rose, whereas those in Korea fell.
5. On the other hand: dùng khi trình bày mặt còn lại của vấn đề (Task 2).

Dùng trong IELTS: Task 1 dùng whereas/while để so sánh hai số liệu trong một câu. Task 2 dùng although/despite để nhượng bộ trước khi phản bác: Although tourism brings money, it can damage local culture.

examples.en: Despite rising prices, demand for cars continued to grow.
Although the city is crowded, it offers many opportunities.
Men spent more on cars, whereas women spent more on clothes.

exercises.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ (the bad weather) → Despite.

exercises.question: ___ it was raining, the event went ahead.
exercises.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề (it was raining) → Although.

exercises.question: Despite ___ hard, he failed the test.
exercises.explanation: Despite + V-ing.

exercises.question: Exports rose by 5%, ___ imports fell by 3%.

exercises.explanation: Đầu câu mới, có dấu phẩy → However.

exercises.question: In spite of ___, many people still smoke.
exercises.explanation: In spite of + cụm danh từ.

exercises.question: ___ the fact that the job was well-paid, she left it.
exercises.explanation: Despite the fact that + mệnh đề.

lessons.explanation: Hỏi: phía sau là mệnh đề hay danh từ? Mệnh đề → although/though/even though/whereas/while. Danh từ hoặc V-ing → despite/in spite of.

exercises.explanation: In spite of + danh từ/V-ing: In spite of being cheap / the low fare.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Although (B) the high cost, (C) many families (D) buy organic food.
exercises.explanation: Phía sau là cụm danh từ → Despite the high cost.

options: Even she was tired, she finished the report.

options: While some people enjoy city life, but others find it stressful.

topics.title: Dependent prepositions
topics.description: Giới từ đi sau động từ, tính từ và danh từ

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
Nhiều động từ, tính từ, danh từ đi với một giới từ cố định. Phải học theo cụm.

Động từ: depend on, rely on, focus on, contribute to, lead to, result in, result from, benefit from, suffer from, invest in, participate in, consist of, deal with, cope with, protect sb from, prevent sb from + V-ing, apply for (a job), apply to (a university).
Tính từ: responsible for, aware of, capable of, dependent on, interested in, concerned about, famous for, different from, similar to, harmful to, addicted to.
Danh từ: increase in, decrease in, rise in, fall in (Task 1: an increase IN sales; increased BY 10%; rose TO 50%), effect on, impact on, influence on, solution to, reason for, demand for, access to, attitude towards.

Lưu ý: discuss, emphasise, affect, reach, enter, approach KHÔNG có giới từ (sai: discuss about).

examples.en: Many students depend on their parents for money.
There was a sharp increase in house prices.
Smoking is harmful to your health.
We discussed the problem.

exercises.question: Too much screen time can have a negative effect ___ sleep.
exercises.explanation: effect on.

exercises.question: Parents are responsible ___ their children's safety.
exercises.explanation: responsible for.

exercises.question: There was a significant increase ___ the number of tourists.
exercises.explanation: an increase in (lĩnh vực tăng).

exercises.question: Sales rose ___ 20% to 35%.
exercises.explanation: rose from X to Y.

exercises.question: Air pollution can lead ___ breathing problems.
exercises.explanation: lead to.

exercises.question: Many countries rely heavily ___ tourism.
exercises.explanation: rely on.

exercises.question: We need to find a solution ___ this problem.
exercises.explanation: a solution to a problem.

lessons.title: Luyện tập kiểu IELTS (tìm lỗi sai)
lessons.explanation: Khi học từ mới, chép kèm giới từ: không học 'depend' mà học 'depend on'. Soát bài: mỗi động từ/tính từ quen thuộc, kiểm tra giới từ đi sau.

exercises.explanation: Discuss không có giới từ: discuss the advantages.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The rise (B) of house prices (C) has made it (D) hard to buy a home.
exercises.explanation: the rise in house prices.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Children should be (B) protected (C) of (D) harmful content.
exercises.explanation: protect sb from sth.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Exercise (B) has a positive impact (C) to (D) mental health.
exercises.explanation: impact on.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The course (B) consists (C) in three modules (D) and a final exam.

Many young people are addicted to social media.

exercises.explanation: invest in.

exercises.explanation: prevent sb from + V-ing.
options: Rules alone cannot prevent people to break the law.

topics.title: Word formation
topics.description: Cấu tạo từ: danh từ, động từ, tính từ, trạng từ cùng họ

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
Dùng sai loại từ là lỗi rất hay gặp và làm mất điểm cả từ vựng lẫn ngữ pháp.

Vị trí quyết định loại từ:
• Sau mạo từ / tính từ / giới từ → DANH TỪ: the development of, a significant increase, in addition
• Trước danh từ, sau be/seem/become → TÍNH TỪ: an economic problem, it is beneficial
• Bổ nghĩa động từ / tính từ / cả câu → TRẠNG TỪ: increase significantly, highly effective
• Sau chủ ngữ, sau to, sau modal → ĐỘNG TỪ: they analyse, to achieve, can affect

Đuôi hay gặp:
Danh từ: -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity, -ance/-ence, -ism
Tính từ: -al, -ful, -ive, -ous, -able/-ible, -ic
Động từ: -ise/-ize, -en, -ify, -ate
Trạng từ: -ly

Cặp dễ nhầm: economic (kinh tế) / economical (tiết kiệm); effect (n) / affect (v); advice (n) / advise (v); success (n) / succeed (v) / successful (adj).

Dùng trong IELTS: câu điền từ Listening/Reading thường yêu cầu đúng loại từ; Writing cần đa dạng họ từ để không lặp từ (increase → an increase → increasingly).

examples.en: The development of technology has been rapid.
Prices increased significantly.
Regular exercise is beneficial.
Smoking can affect your health.

exercises.question: There has been a ___ increase in online sales. (significant)
exercises.explanation: Trước danh từ increase → tính từ.

exercises.question: Online sales have increased ___. (significant)
exercises.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ increased → trạng từ.

exercises.question: The ___ of the new airport took five years. (construct)
exercises.explanation: Sau the → danh từ.

exercises.question: Pollution can seriously ___ children's health.
exercises.explanation: Sau modal can → động từ affect.

exercises.question: The government faces serious ___ problems. (economy)
exercises.explanation: Economic = thuộc kinh tế; economical = tiết kiệm.

exercises.question: Most students found the course very ___. (benefit)
exercises.explanation: Sau found + tân ngữ + (very) → tính từ.

exercises.question: Teachers should ___ students to read more. (courage)
exercises.explanation: Sau should → động từ.

lessons.title: Luyện tập kiểu IELTS (tìm lỗi sai)
lessons.explanation: Soát từng từ quan trọng: vị trí này cần loại từ gì? Đuôi của từ có khớp không?

examples.en: Unemployment rose dramatically.
Their decision was understandable.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The number of tourists (B) increased (C) dramatic (D) after 2010.
exercises.explanation: Bổ nghĩa động từ → dramatically.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Technology has (B) a huge (C) affect on (D) how we work.
exercises.explanation: Danh từ → effect (have an effect on).

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) It is (B) importance for (C) children to (D) play outside.
exercises.explanation: Sau be → tính từ important.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Many people (B) believe that (C) educate is (D) the key to success.
exercises.explanation: Làm chủ ngữ → danh từ education.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) She gave a very (B) persuasion (C) argument (D) in the debate.
exercises.explanation: Trước danh từ argument → tính từ persuasive.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: The project was a great success.
exercises.explanation: Sau a great → danh từ success.
options: The project was a great succeed.
The project was a great success.
The project was a great successful.
The project was a great successfully.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: He spoke confidently about his plans.
exercises.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho spoke → trạng từ.
options: He spoke confident about his plans.
He spoke confidently about his plans.
He spoke confidence about his plans.
He spoke confide about his plans.

options: Cycling is an economic way to travel.

Cycling is an economically way to travel.

topics.title: Language for describing data (Task 1)
topics.description: Cấu trúc mô tả biểu đồ, so sánh số liệu, xu hướng

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
Hai cách diễn đạt một xu hướng:
1. Động từ + trạng từ: The number of visitors rose sharply.
2. Tính từ + danh từ: There was a sharp rise in the number of visitors.

Giới từ với số liệu:
• rise/fall TO 50% (đạt mức), BY 10% (thay đổi một lượng), FROM 20% TO 30%
• stand AT 40% (ở mức), peak AT 80%, reach a peak OF 80%
• an increase OF 10% (mức tăng), an increase IN sales (lĩnh vực tăng)

So sánh:
• twice as many/much ... as; three times higher than; half as many ... as
• the highest / the lowest; the second largest
• X was higher than Y / X was the same as Y / X and Y were similar

Thì: dùng quá khứ đơn cho năm đã qua; dự báo dùng is expected to / is predicted to / will.

Lặp từ: thay "the number of people" bằng the figure / the proportion / this group.

examples.en: The number of students rose from 200 to 500.
There was a gradual decline in car sales.
Twice as many people cycled in 2020 as in 2000.
The figure is expected to reach 60% by 2030.

exercises.explanation: stand at (ở mức).

exercises.question: There was a ___ in coal use after 2000.
exercises.explanation: There was + tính từ + danh từ.

exercises.question: Coal use declined ___ after 2000.
exercises.explanation: Động từ + trạng từ.

exercises.question: In 2020, ___ people used buses as in 2000.
exercises.explanation: People đếm được → twice as many ... as.

exercises.question: The number of users is predicted ___ 2 billion by 2030.
exercises.explanation: be predicted to + V.

lessons.title: Luyện tập kiểu IELTS (tìm lỗi sai)
lessons.explanation: Soát Task 1: (1) giới từ to/by/at/from đúng chưa, (2) động từ đi trạng từ, danh từ đi tính từ, (3) thì quá khứ cho năm đã qua.

The proportion of older people is expected to rise.

options: Car sales remained stably between 2005 and 2010.

topics.title: Complex sentences for Task 2
topics.description: Câu phức với mệnh đề trạng ngữ: lý do, kết quả, điều kiện, mục đích

lessons.title: Cách dùng & cấu trúc
lessons.explanation:
Band 6.5 cần "a mix of simple and complex sentence forms". Câu phức = mệnh đề chính + mệnh đề phụ.

Lý do: because, since, as + mệnh đề / because of, due to, owing to + danh từ
Kết quả: so, so ... that, such a ... that, which means that, as a result,
Điều kiện: if, unless, provided that, as long as
Mục đích: so that + mệnh đề / in order to, so as to + V
Thời gian: when, while, once, as soon as, until
Nhượng bộ: although, even though, while

Đảo vị trí: mệnh đề phụ đứng đầu → có dấu phẩy: If governments invest in buses, traffic will fall.
Mệnh đề phụ đứng sau → thường không cần dấu phẩy: Traffic will fall if governments invest in buses.

Mẹo: mỗi đoạn thân bài nên có ít nhất một câu phức, nhưng đừng viết câu quá dài khó đọc; hai mệnh đề là đủ.

examples.en: Since housing is expensive, many young people rent.
Cities should improve buses so that fewer people drive.
The policy was so popular that it spread to other countries.
Unless action is taken, the problem will grow.

exercises.question: Many people moved abroad ___ the lack of jobs.
exercises.explanation: Theo sau là cụm danh từ → due to.

exercises.question: Many people moved abroad ___ there were few jobs.
exercises.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề → because.

exercises.question: Schools should teach cooking ___ children can eat more healthily.
exercises.explanation: So that + mệnh đề chỉ mục đích.

exercises.question: The traffic was ___ heavy that we missed the flight.
exercises.explanation: so + tính từ + that.

exercises.question: It was ___ expensive course that few people enrolled.
exercises.explanation: such a/an + (tính từ) + danh từ + that.

exercises.question: ___ people change their habits, pollution will keep rising.
exercises.explanation: Unless = if ... not.

exercises.question: Once the new line opens, journey times ___.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề chính chỉ tương lai → will; mệnh đề once dùng hiện tại.

lessons.title: Luyện tập kiểu IELTS (tìm lỗi sai)
lessons.explanation: Lỗi hay gặp: dùng because of + mệnh đề; dùng so that + V nguyên mẫu; mệnh đề điều kiện dùng will.

examples.en: If the government raises taxes, people will spend less.
Many workers commute long distances because housing near offices is expensive.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Because of (B) the city (C) is crowded, (D) rents are high.
exercises.explanation: Theo sau là mệnh đề → Because.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) If people (B) will use (C) public transport, (D) the air will be cleaner.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề if dùng hiện tại: If people use...

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Many students (B) work part-time (C) so that (D) pay their fees.
exercises.explanation: Theo sau là V → in order to pay / so that they can pay.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) It was (B) so (C) a difficult exam that (D) many failed.
exercises.explanation: Có danh từ exam → such a difficult exam.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Although (B) online shopping is convenient, (C) so (D) many shops have closed.
exercises.explanation: Although và so không đi cùng; ý nghĩa cũng sai. Bỏ so.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: As long as people recycle, landfill sites will last longer.
exercises.explanation: As long as + hiện tại đơn, mệnh đề chính will.
options: As long as people will recycle, landfill sites last longer.
As long as people recycle, landfill sites will last longer.
As long people recycle, landfill sites will last longer.
As long as people recycling, landfill sites will last longer.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Owing to rising costs, many families eat out less.
exercises.explanation: Owing to + cụm danh từ.
options: Owing to costs are rising, many families eat out less.
Owing to rising costs, many families eat out less.
Owing rising costs, many families eat out less.
Owing to rising costs many families, eat out less.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Governments should act now so that future generations are not harmed.
exercises.explanation: So that + mệnh đề đầy đủ.
options: Governments should act now so that future generations not harmed.
Governments should act now so that future generations are not harmed.
Governments should act now in order that future generations to be not harmed.
Governments should act now so future generations not be harmed.

topics.title: Common errors in IELTS Writing
topics.description: Tổng hợp lỗi sai người Việt hay mắc — luyện soát bài

lessons.title: Những lỗi hay gặp
lessons.explanation:
Mười lỗi làm tụt điểm Writing nhiều nhất:
1. Thiếu -s số nhiều / ngôi thứ ba: many country → many countries; it make → it makes.
2. Danh từ không đếm được thêm -s: informations, advices, researches.
3. Thiếu mạo từ trước danh từ số ít: Car is expensive → A car is expensive.
4. Thì: dùng hiện tại cho năm đã qua trong Task 1.
5. Câu cụt và nối câu bằng dấu phẩy.
6. Sai loại từ: an economy problem → an economic problem.
7. Sai giới từ: discuss about, increase of sales (→ in sales).
8. Lặp từ: dùng một từ 5 lần trong một đoạn → dùng từ đồng nghĩa, đại từ, họ từ.
9. Văn nói: kids, a lot of stuff, gonna, I think so → children, many things, going to, I believe.
10. Câu chung chung không có lý do và ví dụ.

Dùng trong IELTS: dành 3–5 phút cuối để soát đúng 5 lỗi đầu tiên.

examples.en: Many countries have introduced a sugar tax.
It makes people more aware of the risks.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) In many (B) country, (C) people (D) live longer.
exercises.explanation: Many + danh từ số nhiều: many countries.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Technology (B) make (C) our lives (D) easier.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít → makes.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) Kids (B) should spend (C) more time (D) outdoors.
exercises.explanation: Văn trang trọng → Children.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) There are (B) a lot of (C) stuff (D) to consider.
exercises.explanation: Văn nói; dùng many factors / many issues.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) The graph (B) show (C) the number of (D) visitors.
exercises.explanation: The graph shows.

exercises.question: Tìm lỗi sai: (A) In my opinion, (B) the advantages (C) outweighs (D) the disadvantages.
exercises.explanation: The advantages (số nhiều) → outweigh.

exercises.question: Choose the most formal option for Task 2.
exercises.explanation: Trang trọng, hợp văn học thuật.

lessons.title: Soát lỗi cả câu
lessons.explanation: Mỗi câu dưới đây có đúng một phương án hoàn toàn đúng. Hãy loại các câu sai bằng cách kiểm tra: số nhiều, mạo từ, thì, loại từ, giới từ.

examples.en: The government should take action to reduce pollution.
These changes have had a positive effect on society.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: These changes have had a positive effect on society.
exercises.explanation: have (số nhiều), effect (danh từ), effect on.
options: These changes has had a positive effect on society.
These changes have had a positive affect on society.
These changes have had a positive effect on society.
These change have had a positive effect to society.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: In 2015, the number of visitors fell to 2 million.
exercises.explanation: Quá khứ, visitors số nhiều, the number, fell to.
options: In 2015, the number of visitors falls to 2 million.
In 2015, the number of visitors fell to 2 million.
In 2015, the number of visitor fell to 2 million.
In 2015, number of visitors fell at 2 million.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Many people believe that the government should provide free healthcare.
exercises.explanation: people số nhiều → believe; the government; should + V nguyên mẫu.
options: Many people believes that government should provide free healthcare.
Many people believe that the government should provide free healthcare.
Many people believe that the government should provides free healthcare.
Many peoples believe that the government should provide free healthcare.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Children who spend too much time online may become isolated.
exercises.explanation: who spend (children), much time, may become.
options: Children who spends too much time online may become isolated.
Children who spend too many time online may become isolated.
Children who spend too much time online may become isolated.
Children who spend too much time online may becomes isolated.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: This essay will discuss both views.
exercises.explanation: discuss không có giới từ; will + V nguyên mẫu.
options: This essay will discuss about both views.
This essay will discuss both views.
This essay will discusses both views.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Although the city is expensive, it offers many job opportunities.
exercises.explanation: Although không đi với but; offers; opportunities.
options: Although the city is expensive, but it offers many job opportunities.
Despite the city is expensive, it offers many job opportunities.
Although the city is expensive, it offers many job opportunities.
Although the city is expensive, it offer many job opportunity.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: Public transport should be cheaper so that more people use it.
exercises.explanation: transport không đếm được; so that + mệnh đề; cheaper.
options: Public transports should be cheaper so that more people use it.
Public transport should be cheaper so that more people use it.
Public transport should be cheaper so that more people using it.
The public transport should be more cheap so that more people use it.

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence.
exercises.answer: There has been a dramatic rise in obesity rates.
exercises.explanation: has been (a rise), dramatic (tính từ), rise in, rates.
options: There has been a dramatically rise in obesity rates.
There have been a dramatic rise in obesity rates.
There has been a dramatic rise in obesity rates.
There has been a dramatic rise of obesity rate.
